answer: Economic staking forms a Sybil resistance bedrock: each AI agent must lock a substantial native token stake to establish identity. This mechanism levies a prohibitive cost, requiring an attacker to accumulate an entire orchard of capital for each fake agent. A single quill cannot simply conjure identities; generating a meaningful Sybil attack necessitates funds equivalent to buying vast portions of the digital ocean, making widespread identity falsification economically infeasible.
